coverage.fixture_note: Trimmed test fixture derived from the owner's research pack; counts below describe the ORIGINAL run, not this excerpt.
known_limitations: This is not a complete Canadian provider census, not an OSFI-ordered sample and not a declaration that CMHC approval is a general mortgage licence.
Primary frame substitution: OSFI dataset access failed; readable CMHC NHA approval register used and separately labelled. Provincial/federal expansion remains outstanding.
No assertion of complete product-family coverage even within the 15 reviewed entries; explicit discovery and issuer-attribution gaps remain.
BMO/Scotiabank dynamic rate cells were not readable. Missing prices were not populated from comparison sites or old examples.
B2B rate data was captured from indexed first-party excerpts only and is unverified.
Multiple first-party pages may repeat a shared table; merely having multiple URLs does not establish independent verification.
No personalized underwriting result, commitment or binding quote was obtained.
Many fees, prepayment calculations, eligibility boundaries and loan-size restrictions remain null or unextracted; no industry-default values were invented.
A listed provider can have zero extracted products because of scope, closed programmes, central/member structure or unresolved attribution; zero is not proof it never lends.
CMHC table counts include group-style entries and linked members; 104 must not be used as a national licensed-provider denominator.
Quoted fragments are evidence locators rather than full reproduced documents; pricing entries preserve numeric table cells and conditions. Source pages should be consulted with surrounding terms.
Product availability and source dates vary. Read each record’s gaps and source assertions before downstream ranking or advice.

methodology.confidence: No record upgraded merely for multiple URLs. Single_source can include complementary artifacts where independent agreement on material prices/eligibility was not established. Unverified preserves substantive ambiguity or access-only evidence.
methodology.dates: Retrieval date separate from explicit effective dates, document versions and rate-table revision dates.
methodology.evidence: First-party/regulator URLs only for provider/product facts. PDF facts taken from text and rendered pages. B2B is explicitly search-index-excerpt-only.
methodology.feed: No usable structured mortgage product feed was established for these extracted records. This is not a claim about national open-banking availability.
methodology.identifiers: CA05-CMHC-* identifiers are local catalog IDs only. Numeric register IDs and general licence categories remain null unless actually supplied by an authoritative record.
methodology.pricing_kind: list for extracted published prices/fees, even when final underwriting may alter price. null where no usable current list price or expressly quotation-only basis was established. Null does not mean free.
methodology.product_unit: One marketed family or clearly distinguished open/closed/rate-mechanism variant per record; fixed terms and insurance pricing variants usually grouped in pricing.
methodology.rate_mechanics: Adjustable only when provider explicitly says payments change. Marketing variable name alone is not treated as proof of payment resets.
methodology.scope: Consumer owner-occupied, small-rental and construction mortgages; commercial 5+ unit lender approvals do not by themselves establish a consumer offer.
methodology.taxonomy: Single fixed class per record. Explicit rental programme takes rental_property_mortgage; insurance-only identification takes insured_mortgage; otherwise explicit rate/payment mechanism. No inferred hybrid classification.
